decisions.reason: As an incremental bread that fits the bakery's core know-how and faces no visible sign of underperformance, it likely stays unless sales fall below modest aspiration levels.
The renewed gold medal clearly signals performance above aspiration and comparable rivals, so management would be very unlikely to withdraw it.
This seeded rye mixed bread closely matches established capabilities and current bread demand, so in the absence of negative evidence the firm would normally continue it.
Although still close to the core range, its darker barley-malt profile is somewhat more niche, making it a bit more exposed if results disappoint, but not enough to justify dropping now.
A marzipan stollen suits the firm's seasonal confectionery tradition, and with no evidence of a clear shortfall the firm would likely retain it while monitoring holiday performance.

The ancient grain bread uses familiar baking resources but is the newest and somewhat more experimental item, so management would keep it for now yet with a higher chance of later withdrawal if demand remains uncertain.
